|strategy=By Colin Brown

Scrye Magazine (issue #18) showed a combo using "[[Death Mark]]" and "Meteor Impact." The thing that wasn't mentioned is the various hazards of [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] you can expose that smuggler to. Use "[[Ice Storm (Dark){{!}}Ice Storm]]" to cause the smuggler, and rescue parties, to become missing. Once the site is under nighttime conditions, use cards like "[[Exposure]]" and "[[Frostbite (Dark){{!}}Frostbite]]" to add to the 1 force that is already in use to pay for "[[Death Mark]]."
